entities.summary: Janko Drašković was a Croatian politician who is associated with the beginnings of the Illyrian movement, a 19th-century national revival. Drašković studied law and philosophy before joining the military, from which he was discharged on medical grounds. In the 1790s, Drašković pursued a political career, winning a seat in the Croatian Parliament and in the Diet of Hungary. Janko Drašković was a poets & playwrights from Zagreb (1770-10-20, Zagreb–1856-01-14). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
